card.title: Full Diagnostic Assessment
card.shortDescription: A face-to-face assessment followed by a substantial written report.

modal.title: Full Diagnostic Assessment
bullets: Approximately 3 hours, this can only be completed on individuals who are 8 years or older.
Assessment consists of standardised assessments which reflect strengths and challenges across underlying ability and cognitive processing abilities.
Assessment of attainment in the areas of reading, spelling, and writing.
Detailed diagnostic written report, including recommendations and any considerations for exam access arrangements.
This report will travel with the individual for life as I hold an APC.

schemaOffers.name: Full Diagnostic Assessment (Ages 8+)
schemaOffers.description: A face-to-face assessment followed by a substantial written report. Comprehensive diagnostic assessment including detailed recommendations and considerations for exam access arrangements.

feeRows.label: Full Diagnostic Assessment Report - School Booking

card.title: Spotlight Assessment
card.shortDescription: A face to face assessment followed by a short report. NB This assessment will not diagnose dyslexia.

modal.title: Spotlight Assessment
bullets: Approximately 1.5 hours, this can be completed on children from age 6+

Assessment will cover standardised tests of underlying ability and one further area of cognitive processing; such as phonological processing or working memory. A word reading and word spelling test will also be administered.
Detailed short written report, including recommendations.
Can be accompanied by a pupil focussed observation in class, for an additional fee.

schemaOffers.name: Spotlight Assessment
schemaOffers.description: A face to face assessment followed by a short report. Approximately 1.5 hours covering standardised tests of underlying ability and cognitive processing. For children from age 6+.

modal.title: Pupil Observation
bullets: Focus to be decided prior to observation.
Up to one hour observation in class.
Includes verbal feedback.
Optionally, written feedback can be provided for an additional charge.

schemaOffers.name: Pupil Observation
schemaOffers.description: In class pupil focused observation. Up to one hour observation with verbal feedback and optional written feedback.

My approach is holistic and does not separate learning from emotional and mental wellbeing.
Areas of focus are agreed beforehand.
Six week blocks also available at a cheaper rate.

card.title: Resilience Coaching
card.shortDescription: Curriculum led education and wellness experience for 9 to 18 year olds.

modal.title: Resilience Coaching
bullets: In small groups or 1:1, children and adolescents aged 9 to 18 will learn through experiential activities, videos, games and dynamic exercises, which take place over 11 interactive sessions.
Resilience coaching will empower your child to deal with issues such as self-esteem and labels, using social media, hostile behaviour of others, and disagreements and conflicts.
The Resilience Tutoring package includes the Creating a Resilient Family course for parents.
Resilience and wellbeing training gives your child the confidence to manage feelings and overcome difficulties.
Past participants have reported less anxiety, worry, fear and reactive behaviour and improved relationships with parents, siblings and peers.

schemaOffers.name: Resilience Coaching
